tokens.title: Tokens to scan
tokens.description: One token per line as chain:address. Chains: ethereum, base, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, solana. Example: base:0x940181a94a35a4569e4529a3cdfb74e38fd98631

includeEvidence.title: Include evidence
includeEvidence.description: Add the inputs behind every dimension score (value, points, max) and the inputs left out with the reason.
